verses: The fixed decree of mighty Heaven Had long to Chou assigned the throne, Which first to Wen and Wu was given. Ch'eng next to them as ruler shone. Then the foundations of his power Were made by Ch'eng more deep and sure. Through night and day no idle hour He knew,—the reticent and pure. His virtue wrought, and glorified The heritage he had obtained; Nor were his heart's best powers unplied, Till o'er the land good order reigned.
